15	## Overview
16	`rsc-service` ("Roaming Status Check API for M1", version `2.0.5`, `pom.xml`) is a telecom backend built for M1 Singapore. It checks whether a given MSISDN (mobile subscriber number) is currently roaming by querying the operator's HLR/VLR data through an SPML provisioning-gateway connector, caches results, logs transactions/events, and exposes reporting on those transactions through a separate web UI. It is a Maven multi-module project with three deployable modules: a reactive API service, a log/report data loader, and a Thymeleaf/Keycloak-secured report viewer (`pom.xml` `<modules>`).
17	
18	## Tech Stack
19	- **Language/runtime**: Kotlin 1.9.25 (main API + data loader), Java 21 (report viewer), JDK 21 target (`pom.xml` `java.version`).
20	- **Framework**: Spring Boot 3.5.6 (parent POM), Spring WebFlux + Kotlin coroutines (`rsc-service-api`), Spring MVC + Thymeleaf (`rsc-report-viewer`), Spring Data JDBC/JPA.
21	- **Build**: Maven, multi-module reactor (`rsc-service-parent`).
22	- **Key libraries**: `kotlinx-coroutines-reactor`, `resilience4j` (rate limiter, time limiter) for SPML call protection, `caffeine` (in-memory L1 cache), `mariadb-java-client`, `micrometer-tracing-bridge-brave` + `zipkin-reporter-brave` for distributed tracing, `hms-common-util` / `snmp-log-utils` (internal hSenid libraries for SNMP alarms), `spml-gw` (internal SPML connector library used to talk to the telecom provisioning gateway), Gson, `super-csv` (report export, confirmed in `rsc-report-viewer/pom.xml`), `mockk` / `mockito-kotlin` / `spring-boot-starter-test` / `reactor-test` for testing.
23	- **Data store**: MariaDB 11.4 (two logical DBs: `rsc_config_db` for users/config, `rsc_reporting_db`/`rsc-reporting` for transaction & event logs) — confirmed via `application.yml` datasource URLs and `data/config_db*`, `data/reporting_db*` Liquibase changelogs.
24	- **Auth**: `rsc-service-api` uses HTTP Basic-style `Authorization` header (base64 `user:password`) validated against a DB-backed user table (`VisitorAuthenticator.kt`). `rsc-report-viewer` uses OAuth2/OIDC login against Keycloak (`spring-boot-starter-oauth2-client`, `issuer-uri: https://localhost:8081/realms/rsc-report-viewer` — confirmed in `rsc-report-viewer/src/main/resources/application.yml`).
25	- **Infra**: Docker Compose files for local dev DB/infra and Liquibase migrations (`docker/docker-compose-*.yml`, `liquibase.sh`), HAProxy 2.6.0 mentioned as the fronting LB (Readme.md software versions list), RedHat 9.4 target OS.
26	
27	## Architecture
28	Monolith-ish multi-module system, not a single deployable — three independently built/deployed Spring Boot apps sharing the same MariaDB schemas and internal libraries:
29	
30	```
31	Roaming client (e.g. VPE/other operator)
32	      │ HTTPS + Basic Auth  (GET /vpe/api/visitorInfo/{version}/{msisdn})
33	      ▼
34	rsc-service-api (WebFlux, functional routers)
35	      │
36	      ├─ auth: VisitorAuthenticator ──► rsc_config_db (users/roles)
37	      ├─ workflow: WorkflowChain (chain-of-responsibility validators)
38	      │     NumberLengthValidator → NumberRangeValidator → CheckInCache →
39	      │     SpmlExistsValidator → SingleMsisdnRoamingValidator → MultiSimStatusValidator
40	      ├─ cache: DistributedMsisdnCacheManager — L1 Caffeine (per-instance) + L2 MariaDB
41	      │     (shared/distributed), background sync (30s) + cleanup (2min) schedulers
42	      ├─ connectors: SpmlConnectorAdapter → spml-gw library → SPML/XML provisioning
43	      │     gateway (HLR/VLR search + multi-SIM member check), rate-limited via resilience4j
44	      ├─ logs: TransLogger / EventLogger → transaction & event log tables/files
45	      └─ snmp: CommonSNMPManager → SNMP traps for DB errors, high TPS, timeouts, start/stop
46	
47	rsc-data-loader (Kotlin, scheduled batch/log processor)
48	      reads trans/event log files → parses via ColumnSpec/Transformers →
49	      writes to rsc_reporting_db (trans_log, tps_log, trx_events_log tables) →
50	      ReportGeneratorService produces summary/detail report tables
51	
52	rsc-report-viewer (Spring MVC + Thymeleaf, Keycloak OAuth2 login)
53	      ReportingController/ReportingService → DetailTransactionRepository (JPA/JDBC)
54	      → reads rsc_reporting_db → renders/downloads CSV reports (super-csv)
55	```
56	
57	## Modules / Components
58	- **rsc-service-api** — Reactive API that answers roaming-status lookups for MSISDNs against the telecom HLR/VLR via SPML, with caching, validation chain, auth, and alarms. Path: `rsc-service-api/src/main/kotlin/hms/core/m1/rsc/rscservice/`
59	  - `api/` — WebFlux functional route definitions (`RouteConfiguration.kt`) for `visitorInfo`, user management (`/user/add`, `/user/update-password`, `/user/change-status`), and cache admin (`/clear-cache`, `/clear-all-cache`).
60	  - `workflow/` — `WorkflowChain`/`WorkFlowStep` chain-of-responsibility pattern driving the roaming-check pipeline and building the response/cache entry.
61	  - `validator/` — individual chain steps: MSISDN length/range checks, SPML existence check, single-MSISDN roaming determination, multi-SIM status check, cache short-circuit (`CheckInCache`).
62	  - `connectors/` — `SpmlConnectorAdapter` wraps the internal `spml-gw` library to send XML SPML requests (`search_request.xml`, `multi_sim_member_check_request.xml`) and parse HLR/VLR/call-barring (odboc) XPath responses.
63	  - `cache/` — `DistributedMsisdnCacheManager` (hybrid L1 Caffeine + L2 MariaDB cache), `CacheRepository`, sync/cleanup schedulers.
64	  - `auth/` — Basic-auth style `VisitorAuthenticator`, DB-backed user repo/entity, `PasswordService`, `UserRoles` (ADMIN/USER).
65	  - `logs/` — `TransLogger`/`EventLogger`/TPS logger writing transaction, event, and TPS logs consumed later by `rsc-data-loader`.
66	  - `snmp/`, `alarms/` — SNMP trap alarms for DB errors, consecutive timeouts, high TPS, app start/stop.
67	  - `error/` — typed exceptions (`ApiErrorException`, `InternalErrorException`, `UnauthorizedException`, `ForbiddenException`, `DefaultErrorException`) mapped to HTTP statuses.
68	- **rsc-data-loader** — Batch/scheduled Kotlin service that parses trans/event/TPS log files and loads them into the reporting DB, then generates summary reports. Path: `rsc-data-loader/src/main/kotlin/hms/core/m1/rsc/dataloader/`
69	  - `logspecs/` — column specs and field `Transformer`s (`NullColumnTransformer`, `BooleanFieldTransformer`, `FieldWithColumnNameTransformer`) describing log file layouts.
70	  - `service/lineProcessor/`, `service/loadInFileProcessor/` — log line/file ingestion pipeline (`TransLogProcessor`, `LoadInFileProcessor`).
71	  - `service/reportGenerator/` — `ReportGeneratorService`/`ReportGeneratorRepository` builds summary/detail report tables.
72	  - `service/lock/` — `DistributedTemplateLockManager` (DB-based distributed locking, likely to keep multi-instance loaders from double-processing).
73	  - `snmp/` — SNMP alarm config mirroring the API module.
74	- **rsc-report-viewer** — Spring MVC web app (Java) with Keycloak SSO login for viewing/exporting roaming transaction reports. Path: `rsc-report-viewer/src/main/java/hms/core/m1/rsc/rscservice/viewer/`
75	  - `controller/` — `LoginController`, `ReportingController`.
76	  - `service/`, `service/impl/` — `ReportingService`/`ReportingServiceImpl`.
77	  - `repository/` — `DetailTransactionRepository`, `UserRepository` (JPA).
78	  - `configuration/` — `SecurityConfiguration`, `AuthoritiesConverter`, `CustomAuthenticationEvents` (Keycloak/OAuth2 role mapping).
79	  - `validator/` — `DetailTransactionReportValidator`, `DateFormatValidator` for report query params.
80	  - `health/` — `DbHealthChecker`.
81	  - `keycloak/theme/` — custom Keycloak login theme.
82	- **data/** — Liquibase changelogs for the four MariaDB schemas: `config_db`, `config_db_test`, `reporting_db`, `reporting_db_test`, plus `initial-data/` scripts (user seeding, `trx_events_log`/`trans_log`/`tps_log` partitioning). Path: `data/`
83	- **simulators/rsc-service-simulator/** — WireMock-based standalone simulator (jar + `mappings/`) used to fake SPML/downstream responses for testing (roaming true/false, unauthorized, bad-request, not-acceptable, internal-error scenarios). Path: `simulators/rsc-service-simulator/`
84	- **docs/** — HLD PlantUML/PNG diagrams (system context, API/report-viewer/data-loader component diagrams, deployment, DB designs) under `docs/hld/`, SRS/SOW/flow requirement docs under `docs/req/`, and real SPML XML/WSDL/XSD samples under `docs/spml_samples/`. Path: `docs/`

86	- **QA agent pipeline scaffold** (`config/`, `prompts/`, `templates/`, `output/`, `dashboard/`, `scripts/`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `VERSION`, root `README.md`) — this is tooling for the QA pipeline itself (this analysis run), not part of the deployed rsc-service product; confirmed untracked in `git status` in the target repo. Not a runtime component of the product under test.
87	
88	## Integration Points
89	- **SPML (XML over HTTP, via internal `spml-gw` connector library)** — outbound integration to the telecom Provisioning Gateway for HLR/VLR search (`search_request.xml`) and multi-SIM member check (`multi_sim_member_check_request.xml`); WSDL/XSD in `rsc-service-api/src/main/resources/spml/wsdl/` and `docs/spml_samples/`. Rate-limited to 50 req/s via `resilience4j` (`application.yml` `resilience4j.ratelimiter.instances.spml-requests`).
90	- **REST (Basic Auth) inbound API** — `rsc-service-api`, base path `/vpe/api` (`application.yml` `spring.webflux.base-path`): `GET /visitorInfo/{version}/{msisdn}`, `POST /user/add`, `PUT /user/update-password/{username}`, `PUT /user/change-status/{username}`, `DELETE /clear-cache/{msisdn}`, `GET /clear-all-cache` (`RouteConfiguration.kt`, lines 59/86/98/111/124/139 — re-verified this run, unchanged).
91	- **OAuth2/OIDC via Keycloak** — `rsc-report-viewer` login, issuer `https://localhost:8081/realms/rsc-report-viewer` (dev config; confirm prod issuer separately — not confirmed).
92	- **MariaDB** — shared L2 cache table + config/user data (`rsc_config_db`) for `rsc-service-api`; transaction/event/summary report tables (`rsc_reporting_db`) written by `rsc-data-loader` and read by `rsc-report-viewer`. Connection via `mariadb-java-client` + HikariCP.
93	- **SNMP traps** — `CommonSNMPManager` (internal `snmp-log-utils` lib) sends traps for DB errors, consecutive timeouts, high TPS, and app start/stop, via a configured shell script (`service-api.snmp.snmp-file-path: /hms/scripts/sample_snmp.sh`).
94	- **Distributed tracing** — Brave/Zipkin via Micrometer Tracing (`micrometer-tracing-bridge-brave`), trace ID surfaced in logs and as `X-Trace-Id`-style context (`Context.traceId`).
95	- **Liquibase** — schema migration/versioning for all four MariaDB schemas (`liquibase.sh`, `data/*/changelog`, `docker/docker-compose-db-migrate-*.yml`).
96	
97	## Test Conventions
98	- **Framework**: JUnit 5 via `spring-boot-starter-test`, `mockk` (Kotlin-idiomatic mocking) and `mockito-kotlin` as mocking libraries, `reactor-test` for WebFlux/coroutine flows. Report viewer additionally uses `spring-security-test` and `kotlin-test`.
99	- **Layout**: mirrors main source package structure under `src/test/kotlin/...` (`rsc-service-api`) and `src/test/java/...` (`rsc-report-viewer`); one test class generally per main class (e.g. `DefaultSpmlConnectorAdapterTest.kt`, `VisitorAuthenticatorTest.kt`, `SecurityConfigurerTest.kt`, validator-specific tests under `validator/`).
100	- **Naming**: `<ClassUnderTest>Test.kt`/`.java`; some split across numbered files for large suites (`TpsLoggerImplTest`, `TpsLoggerImplTest1`, `2`, `3`).
101	- **Test config**: `rsc-service-api/src/test/resources/application.yml` overrides for test runs.
102	- **Local run**: `mvn clean install -DskipTest` for build; `docker-compose-dev-infa.yml` + `docker-compose-dev-test-infa.yml` for local infra, then `docker-compose-db-migrate-rsc-*-db.yml` / `*-test-db.yml` to create schemas (Readme.md). `data/initial-data/add-user.sql` seeds users; partitioning script must be run before load (`trx_events_log`, `trans_log`, `tps_log`).
103	- **External dependency simulation**: `simulators/rsc-service-simulator/` (WireMock) stands in for the SPML gateway with canned scenario mappings (roaming true/false, unauthorized, bad request, not-acceptable, internal error, delayed response) — useful for both manual and integration testing of `rsc-service-api` without a real HLR/VLR connection.
104	- **CI**: No CI pipeline definition (`.gitlab-ci.yml`, `Jenkinsfile`, GitHub Actions) found in the repository — re-confirmed this run (no matches for `Jenkinsfile`/`*.gitlab-ci*`). Not confirmed how/where automated tests run in CI. SonarQube scan is documented as a manual `mvn sonar:sonar` command (Readme.md), not confirmed to be wired into CI.
105	
106	## Risk Notes
107	- **External SPML/HLR dependency is the critical path** — every roaming check calls out to the telecom Provisioning Gateway; `DefaultSpmlConnectorAdapter` wraps failures in generic `InternalErrorException`, and a documented open question in `docs/hld/hld_review.md` notes SPML connector delay/TPS is not fully understood ("What is the average delay for SPML connector at the moment", "Max tps for calling SPML is 50TPS... Need to monitor the SPML TPS"). Rate limiting is fixed at 50/s — worth confirming behavior under throttling/backpressure.
108	- **Hybrid cache correctness** — L1 (Caffeine, per-instance) vs L2 (MariaDB, shared) can diverge; sync runs every 30s, cleanup every 2min (`application.yml` `cache.sync.scheduler`, `cache.cleanup.scheduler`). The most recent product commit (`5c0d862`, tagged into release `2.0.5`, still HEAD's most recent product change as of this run) specifically touched `DistributedMsisdnCacheManager.kt` to "fix non & neighbouring countries cache time based on Vlr" — this cache-TTL-by-VLR logic remains the freshest change and should stay a priority regression-test area until a newer commit supersedes it. Multi-instance deployments should also be tested for stale-cache/race conditions, especially around `clear-cache`/`clear-all-cache` admin endpoints only clearing local vs distributed state.
109	- **Auth is custom, not framework-based, in rsc-service-api** — `VisitorAuthenticator` manually decodes Basic-Auth header and checks a DB-backed user table with a custom `PasswordService`; no Spring Security filter chain enforcing this, so any new route must remember to call `authenticate(...)` explicitly or it is unprotected by default (`RouteConfiguration.kt`).
110	- **Two different auth models across modules** — `rsc-service-api` (Basic Auth + DB users) vs `rsc-report-viewer` (Keycloak OAuth2/OIDC) — a tester must treat these as separate boundaries with separate credentials.
111	- **MSISDN regex-driven business rules** are config-driven and easy to get subtly wrong: `service-api.roaming-inactive-msisdn`, `msisdn-validations.range`, `msisdn-status-cache.neighbouring-countries-vlrAddress` in `application.yml` directly control roaming/multi-sim/caching logic — any change to these regexes changes business behavior without a code change.
112	- **Log-to-report pipeline has multiple hops** (`rsc-service-api` writes trans/event logs → `rsc-data-loader` parses and loads into `rsc_reporting_db` → `rsc-report-viewer` reads/exports) — data can be lost or delayed at any hop; partitioning of `trx_events_log`/`trans_log`/`tps_log` must be pre-created or inserts fail (Readme.md warning).
113	- **Secrets/credentials in resources** — `rsc-service-api/src/main/resources/application.yml` contains a default DB password (`password`) and an SSL keystore password (`password`), and a committed `.p12` keystore and SPML client keystore (`spml/keystore/client.jks`) — confirmed still present, unchanged this run; confirm these are dev-only and rotated for other environments; not confirmed whether prod uses externalized secrets.
114	- **SNMP alerting depends on an external shell script path** (`/hms/scripts/sample_snmp.sh`) — if missing/misconfigured in an environment, DB error / high-TPS / timeout alarms silently won't fire.
115	
116	## Not Confirmed
117	- Whether/where CI actually runs `mvn test`/`mvn verify` — no CI config file found in the repo (re-checked this run).
118	- Production Keycloak issuer/realm configuration (only a `localhost:8081` dev value was found).
119	- Exact list of consumers/clients calling `rsc-service-api` (referred to generically as "VPE"/other operator systems in code comments and docs) — not traced beyond the API contract itself.
120	- Whether SSL (`server.ssl.enabled`) is actually turned on in any deployed environment — it's `false` in the checked-in `application.yml`.
121	- Deployment topology (Active/Active, region layout) — mentioned as an open HLD question (`docs/hld/hld_review.md`), not confirmed as implemented.
122	- Whether `rsc-data-loader` runs continuously as a service or as a scheduled batch job — code shows scheduling/locking (`DistributedTemplateLockManager`) but the exact trigger cadence was not traced into resource/config files.

## Architecture
Monolith-ish multi-module system, not a single deployable — three independently built/deployed Spring Boot apps sharing the same MariaDB schemas and internal libraries:

```
Roaming client (e.g. VPE/other operator)
      │ HTTPS + Basic Auth  (GET /vpe/api/visitorInfo/{version}/{msisdn})
      ▼
rsc-service-api (WebFlux, functional routers)
      │
      ├─ auth: VisitorAuthenticator ──► rsc_config_db (users/roles)
      ├─ workflow: WorkflowChain (chain-of-responsibility validators)
      │     NumberLengthValidator → NumberRangeValidator → CheckInCache →
      │     SpmlExistsValidator → SingleMsisdnRoamingValidator → MultiSimStatusValidator
      ├─ cache: DistributedMsisdnCacheManager — L1 Caffeine (per-instance) + L2 MariaDB
      │     (shared/distributed), background sync (30s) + cleanup (2min) schedulers
      ├─ connectors: SpmlConnectorAdapter → spml-gw library → SPML/XML provisioning
      │     gateway (HLR/VLR search + multi-SIM member check), rate-limited via resilience4j
      ├─ logs: TransLogger / EventLogger → transaction & event log tables/files
      └─ snmp: CommonSNMPManager → SNMP traps for DB errors, high TPS, timeouts, start/stop

rsc-data-loader (Kotlin, scheduled batch/log processor)
      reads trans/event log files → parses via ColumnSpec/Transformers →
      writes to rsc_reporting_db (trans_log, tps_log, trx_events_log tables) →
      ReportGeneratorService produces summary/detail report tables

rsc-report-viewer (Spring MVC + Thymeleaf, Keycloak OAuth2 login)
      ReportingController/ReportingService → DetailTransactionRepository (JPA/JDBC)
      → reads rsc_reporting_db → renders/downloads CSV reports (super-csv)
```

## Risk Notes
- **External SPML/HLR dependency is the critical path** — every roaming check calls out to the telecom Provisioning Gateway; `DefaultSpmlConnectorAdapter` wraps failures in generic `InternalErrorException`, and a documented open question in `docs/hld/hld_review.md` notes SPML connector delay/TPS is not fully understood ("What is the average delay for SPML connector at the moment", "Max tps for calling SPML is 50TPS... Need to monitor the SPML TPS"). Rate limiting is fixed at 50/s — worth confirming behavior under throttling/backpressure.
- **Hybrid cache correctness** — L1 (Caffeine, per-instance) vs L2 (MariaDB, shared) can diverge; sync runs every 30s, cleanup every 2min (`application.yml` `cache.sync.scheduler`, `cache.cleanup.scheduler`). The most recent product commit (`5c0d862`, tagged into release `2.0.5`, still HEAD's most recent product change as of this run) specifically touched `DistributedMsisdnCacheManager.kt` to "fix non & neighbouring countries cache time based on Vlr" — this cache-TTL-by-VLR logic remains the freshest change and should stay a priority regression-test area until a newer commit supersedes it. Multi-instance deployments should also be tested for stale-cache/race conditions, especially around `clear-cache`/`clear-all-cache` admin endpoints only clearing local vs distributed state.
- **Auth is custom, not framework-based, in rsc-service-api** — `VisitorAuthenticator` manually decodes Basic-Auth header and checks a DB-backed user table with a custom `PasswordService`; no Spring Security filter chain enforcing this, so any new route must remember to call `authenticate(...)` explicitly or it is unprotected by default (`RouteConfiguration.kt`).
- **Two different auth models across modules** — `rsc-service-api` (Basic Auth + DB users) vs `rsc-report-viewer` (Keycloak OAuth2/OIDC) — a tester must treat these as separate boundaries with separate credentials.
- **MSISDN regex-driven business rules** are config-driven and easy to get subtly wrong: `service-api.roaming-inactive-msisdn`, `msisdn-validations.range`, `msisdn-status-cache.neighbouring-countries-vlrAddress` in `application.yml` directly control roaming/multi-sim/caching logic — any change to these regexes changes business behavior without a code change.
- **Log-to-report pipeline has multiple hops** (`rsc-service-api` writes trans/event logs → `rsc-data-loader` parses and loads into `rsc_reporting_db` → `rsc-report-viewer` reads/exports) — data can be lost or delayed at any hop; partitioning of `trx_events_log`/`trans_log`/`tps_log` must be pre-created or inserts fail (Readme.md warning).
- **Secrets/credentials in resources** — `rsc-service-api/src/main/resources/application.yml` contains a default DB password (`password`) and an SSL keystore password (`password`), and a committed `.p12` keystore and SPML client keystore (`spml/keystore/client.jks`) — confirmed still present, unchanged this run; confirm these are dev-only and rotated for other environments; not confirmed whether prod uses externalized secrets.
- **SNMP alerting depends on an external shell script path** (`/hms/scripts/sample_snmp.sh`) — if missing/misconfigured in an environment, DB error / high-TPS / timeout alarms silently won't fire.
